plugins.name: Developer Role Normalizer
plugins.description: Converts developer message roles to system for OpenAI-compatible providers (e.g. DeepSeek) that do not recognize the developer role.
plugins.author: xinghaix

plugins.name: CPA Manager Plus
plugins.description: In-process local Runtime for Manager Plus dashboard, usage, monitoring, and real Codex/xAI credential health inspection in CPA (local SQLite; no external Manager Server).
plugins.author: xinghaix

plugins.name: Codex OAuth Base URL
plugins.description: Rewrites the upstream base URL of Codex OAuth (ChatGPT subscription) credentials so a Codex account can target a self-hosted or third-party upstream.
plugins.author: xinghaix

plugins.name: Codex Window Keeper
plugins.description: Tracks each Codex OAuth account's actual quota windows and sends one pinned Responses message when observed exhausted windows recover; persists scheduler state in one SQLite database.
plugins.author: xinghaix

plugins.name: Cursor OAuth
plugins.description: Cursor OAuth credentials provider and executor plugin for CLIProxyAPI with thinking stream, constraint injection, and official brand assets.
plugins.author: kilolonion
